services.desc: If you book a trip and end up coming back to dock before the amount of time you booked you will still be charged for the trip that you booked. For instance, If you booked a 6 hour and someone gets sick and you return to the dock in 4 hours then you will still be charged for a 6 hour trip. The reason for this is because you have kept us from booking other trips because we guaranteed you this time frame when you booked the trip. If the trip is ended before the time booked due to unsafe weather conditions or any other reason the captain sees necessary then your time paid for will be negotiated and refund may be given for hours not fished.
